why: No major reviewer or authority shows up. The only official pages are UGREEN's and QNAP's own pages about their products. The best results are niche sites (Wundertech, The Post Flow, Terabytewise) that pick models from specs and reasoning, without checkable tests. Most of the rest are affiliate roundups on recycled domains whose test claims nobody can verify. A focused page that compares 10GbE and Thunderbolt NAS models with current prices and a direct pick for solo editors and for small teams could rank and get cited.
